title: Frustrating experience trying to get models to run.
summary: ## Expected Behavior The model either works, or provides a clear error message on why it can't Ideally it filters the models dropdown by the models that my system is capable running, instead of having me figure it out. ## Actual Behavior Cryptic error messages and failed chats ## Steps to Reproduce the Problem 1. installed Foundry local in vscode 2. installed CUDA 13.3.0 3. restarted visual studio code 4. All optimized models throw cryptic error mesages ## Specifications - extension version: 1.4.2 - Version: vscode 1.123.0 - Platform: Windows x64 I tried -npu, -cuda, -gpu -openvino models. title: Common limitations and workarounds
summary: The current state of klp-build is not meant to handle some specific case, a few of them are: 1) backports of a specific branch have not landed in the product branch yet but still lives in the user branches 2) backports without a CVE reference I am opening this issue to document workarounds that can be useful when working on a livepatch that falls into these cases. The end goal should be to extend the implementation of klp-build to cover these cases as well, however the current top priorities of the team do not cover it and such implementation might be delayed. So for the time being, let's keep this open bug to have a quick how-to reference for handling them. --- ## 1) Some high priority bug requires to work on a livepatch before the backports are merged into the product branches. In order not to wait the maintaners to merge them, we can quickly workaround it by adjusting the klp-build source as follows: ```diff diff --git a/klpbuild/klplib/ksrc.py b/klpbuild/klplib/ksrc.py index e91c6ae..013011b 100644 --- a/klpbuild/klplib/ksrc.py +++ b/klpbuild/klplib/ksrc.py @@ -19,17 +19,17 @@ from klpbuild.klplib.kernel_tree import (get_commit_data, find_commit) KERNEL_BRANCHES = { - "12.5": "SLE12-SP5", - "15.4": "SLE15-SP4-LTSS", - "15.5": "SLE15-SP5-LTSS", - "15.6": "SLE15-SP6-LTSS", - "15.7": "SLE15-SP7", - "15.7rt": "SLE15-SP7-RT", - "16.0": "SL-16.0", - "16.0rt": "SL-16.0", - "6.0": "SUSE-2024", - "6.0rt": "SUSE-2024-RT", - "cve-5.14": "cve/linux-5.14-LTSS", + "12.5": "users/ /SLE12-SP5/for-next", + "15.4": "users/ /cve/linux-5.14-LTSS/for-next", + "15.5": "users/ /cve/linux-5.14-LTSS/for-next", + "15.6": "users/ /SLE15-SP6-LTSS/for-next", + "15.7": "users/ /SLE15-SP6-LTSS/for-next", + "15.7rt": "users/ /SLE15-SP6-LTSS/for-next", + "16.0": "users/ /SL-16.0/for-next", + "16.0rt": "users/ /SL-16.0/for-next", + "6.0": "users/
